description: Ministry of Defence - The Uttama Sewa Padakkama - 2022
categorisation: This gazette exclusively announces personnel awards (Utthama Seva Padakkama) to named individuals in the Sri Lankan armed forces. It contains a detailed schedule listing specific officers by name, rank, and regiment. While it mentions the President's authority to award these medals, it does not describe any structural changes to government departments or detailed portfolio responsibilities for the individuals. The content focuses solely on recognizing specific people for their service.
